mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_report_task (session_id, attempt_version, task_state, delivery_state, next_send_at, queued_at, queue_deadline) VALUES (#{task.sessionId}, #{task.attemptVersion}, 'QUEUED', 'PENDING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{queueSeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM interview_report_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM interview_report_task WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND task_state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
SELECT * FROM interview_report_task WHERE task_state = 'QUEUED' AND queue_deadline <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY queue_deadline, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM interview_report_task WHERE task_state = 'RUNNING' AND execution_deadline <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY execution_deadline, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_report_task SET delivery_state = 'LEASED', dispatch_token = #{token}, dispatch_lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), send_attempts = send_attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND task_state = 'QUEUED' AND queue_deadline > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND send_attempts < #{maxAttempts} AND ((delivery_state = 'PENDING' AND next_send_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (delivery_state = 'LEASED' AND dispatch_lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))
UPDATE interview_report_task SET delivery_state = 'SENT', dispatch_token = NULL, dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND delivery_state = 'LEASED' AND dispatch_token = #{token}

UPDATE interview_report_task SET task_state = 'RUNNING', execution_version = #{executionVersion}, started_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), execution_deadline = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{executionSeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id} AND task_state = 'QUEUED' AND attempt_version = #{attemptVersion} AND queue_deadline > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE interview_report_task SET task_state = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode} WHERE id = #{id} AND task_state = #{state} AND task_state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
